description:
A Privacy-first, Cross-platform Text Expander


Automatically released by CI, manually edited by Auca
Hey there! I'm back to manually written release docs, so here we go:
This release focus on the fix of #2748 (PR #2761 thanks to @YuriNachos ), available in all platforms
Also, we feature two improvements:
- linux: install desktop file and icon + improvements (#2757 by @xuars )
- fix(daemon/macos): take over stale daemon lock after logout/login (#2749 by @robwilkerson )
And minor adjustments to the repo:
- Add inspect.software health badge (#2780 by @Nayjest )
Have fun!
